# data-sa-068 Statistical analysis text comparison task.

## Task Instructions
Perform a two-sample t-test to assess the shot power of left-footed and right-footed players using FIFA20 data. Calculate the t-statistic and p-value. With a threshold of 0.05, determine if "There is a significant difference" or "There is no significant difference". Format your response like this:
```
{ "T-Statistic": [...], "P-Value": [...], "Conclusion": [...]
}
```
